description: The bar chart illustrates F1 Score performance (in percent) across multiple datasets for four MADLLM-related model variants. The horizontal axis contains the categorical variable “Dataset,” listing SMD, PSM, SWaT, SMAP, MSL, and WADI from left to right, and the vertical axis is labeled “F1 Score (%)” on a linear scale ranging from 60 to 100 with tick marks at 60, 70, 80, 90, and 100. For each dataset, four adjacent bars are shown in a consistent left-to-right color order: green for “MADLLM,” purple for “MADLLM w/o feature embedding,” blue for “MADLLM w/o maxpool,” and orange for “MADLLM w/o skip embedding,” as indicated by the legend below the plot. Approximate bar heights are: SMD—green ~93, purple ~91, blue ~92, orange ~92; PSM—green ~97, purple ~96, blue ~77, orange ~95; SWaT—green ~91, purple ~90, blue ~83, orange ~85; SMAP—green ~93, purple ~69, blue ~69, orange ~67; MSL—green ~87, purple ~85, blue ~69, orange ~85; WADI—green ~74, purple ~62, blue ~64, orange ~68. The bars are grouped by dataset (not stacked), there is no explicit sorting beyond the fixed dataset order on the x-axis, and no bars appear specially emphasized with annotations or distinctive outlines beyond the standard black bar borders.
